subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Tips for Human Creators in an AI World, PBS Fun, On Crafting Beautiful Endings, and More

bullets.title: Well-rounded doesn’t cut
bullets.creator: Derek Sivers
bullets.note: . Pair with “[1,000 True Fans](https://kk.org/thetechnium/1000-true-fans/)” by [Kevin Kelly](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eZ3Y_rjKvIE) for a potent combo. These two philosophies will become even more valuable in the coming AI deluge of machine-created content. To surf above the tsunami, I suggest one human-scale win at a time. Think big first, and you’ll likely get lost, defeated by AIs instructed to do the same. Think small, and you’ll have a better chance of enduring… and snowballing into something big.

This one has everything: dulcet tones, belting, funky riffs, and a few drops of the hammer. This oldie underscores a lot of what I love about Sevendust. If you have a chance to see them live, take it.

bullets.title: My appearance on To Dine For with Kate Sullivan_.
bullets.note: My first appearance on PBS! I grew up on PBS, and certain series, like [_Joseph Campbell and_ _The Power of Myth_](https://tim.blog/2020/08/27/the-power-of-myth-joseph-campbell/?utm_campaign=5bf&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_source=convertkit#content) ([video](https://www.amazon.com/Joseph-Campbell-Power-Myth-Moyers/dp/B07BC61WHS/), [audio](https://tim.blog/2020/08/27/the-power-of-myth-joseph-campbell/?utm_campaign=5bf&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_source=convertkit#content)), left an indelible mark. In _To Dine For with Kate Sullivan_, four-time Emmy Award-winning journalist [Kate Sullivan](https://www.instagram.com/todinefortv/?hl=en) accompanies guests to their favorite restaurants and explores their lives and thinking. Kate kindly invited me last summer to join her in New York City. I picked [Hearth](https://www.restauranthearth.com/), which was founded by [Chef Marco Canora](https://tim.blog/2021/11/10/marco-canora/?utm_campaign=5bf&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_source=convertkit#content), whom many will recognize from his extensive appearances in [_The 4-Hour Chef_](https://www.amazon.com/4-Hour-Chef-Cooking-Learning-Anything/dp/1328519163/) as one of my main teachers. I had a blast. Thank you again for having me, Kate and team!

bullets.title: WTF? Marc Maron ends his podcast after 16 years
bullets.creator: Steve Bennett
bullets.note: . This is a wonderfully warm closing of the curtain. Endings can be as beautiful as beginnings, and I think Marc’s words are worth savoring. His podcast was one of the handful in 2012–13 that inspired me to start my own.
